instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Rank rows by distance within each player_id
output: SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY distance DESC) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Dense rank of rows by distance
output: SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY distance DESC) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Row number per player_id ordered by run_date
output: SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY run_date) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Running total of distance ordered by run_date
output: SELECT *, SUM(distance) OVER (ORDER BY run_date) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Running total of distance per player_id
output: SELECT *, SUM(distance) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY run_date) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Average of distance over all rows
output: SELECT *, AVG(distance) OVER () FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Previous distance value (lag) per player_id
output: SELECT *, LAG(distance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY run_date) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Next distance value (lead) per player_id
output: SELECT *, LEAD(distance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY run_date) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Maximum distance per player_id across all rows
output: SELECT *, MAX(distance) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Minimum distance per player_id
output: SELECT *, MIN(distance) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Moving average window of 3 rows per player_id
output: SELECT *, AVG(distance) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY run_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Window frame from first row to current per player_id
output: SELECT *, SUM(distance) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY run_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
First value of distance per player_id
output: SELECT *, FIRST_VALUE(distance) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY run_date) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Last value of distance per player_id across full partition
output: SELECT *, LAST_VALUE(distance) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY run_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Percent rank of distance
output: SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY distance) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Cumulative distribution of distance
output: SELECT *, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY distance) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Quartile bucket using NTILE
output: SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY distance) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Difference of distance from its group max
output: SELECT player_id, distance, distance - MAX(distance) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS diff FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Rank of distance with ties allowed to skip
output: SELECT player_id, distance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY distance DESC) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Sliding window of total over preceding 5 rows
output: SELECT *, SUM(distance) OVER (ORDER BY run_date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Running count per player_id
output: SELECT *, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY run_date) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Top 2 by distance within each player_id using ROW_NUMBER
output: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY distance DESC) rn FROM runs) x WHERE rn <= 2;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Nth value of distance within partition
output: SELECT *, NTH_VALUE(distance, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY run_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Expressed ratio of distance to group total
output: SELECT player_id, distance, distance / SUM(distance) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS ratio FROM runs;

instruction:
Schema: runs(player_id, distance, run_date)
Window with custom unbounded following frame
output: SELECT *, SUM(distance) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY run_date ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM runs;
